description: All-GPT codex line — flash uses gpt-6-luna for near-zero-cost exploration at $0.1/$0.5 with 1M context, standard/pro/max run gpt-6-sol at $2/$10: the 6-line dropped terra, and sol is cheaper than 5.6-terra while gpt-6-astra ($10/$50) breaches the $3/$15 red line, so sol is both the orchestration tier and the strongest in-family survivor; vision reuses luna (6-line supports image inputs). Requires OPENCODE_API_KEY environment variable (OpenCode Zen).
